title: Particle Burst Send
visualTrait: A compact action button emits a playful burst of particles after activation.
sourceName: Particle Effects for Buttons
captureHint: Click Send, then capture the button and its particle burst against the dark demo canvas.

title: Magnetic Circle CTA
visualTrait: A circular outlined CTA and inner text pull independently toward the cursor for a parallax magnetic effect.
sourceName: Magnetic Buttons inspired by Cuberto
captureHint: Move the cursor near Send and capture the displaced circle, text, and shadow.

title: SVG Noise Distortion
visualTrait: A set of minimalist button treatments warp and smear through SVG filter distortion on interaction.
sourceName: Distorted Button Effects Using SVG Filters
captureHint: Hover or click one numbered Click me variation and crop a single distorted state.

title: Gooey Blob Hover
visualTrait: A light pill button grows two rounded blobs through an SVG goo filter over a charcoal background.
sourceName: Gooey button hover effect with SVG filters & CSS by Ines
captureHint: Hover the centered button and crop the expanded blob silhouette.

title: Hold-to-Publish Confirmation
visualTrait: A hold interaction cycles text while a circular SVG progress ring completes into a checkmark.
sourceName: (v2) Button - Hold to confirm (Accessible) by Aaron Iker
captureHint: Press and hold until the ring is mid-progress or the final tick is visible.

title: Glass Morphism Action
visualTrait: A translucent frosted-glass button is presented as one of several interactive visual button recipes.
sourceName: Interactive Buttons Collection
captureHint: Crop the Glass Morphism card tightly around its button and label.

title: Animated Icon Circle
visualTrait: An icon-only circular control uses layered pseudo-elements and motion to animate the directional glyph.
sourceName: Part 04, 05, 06: Animated Buttons - Mastering CSS Animations by CodyHouse
captureHint: Hover the round icon-button variant and capture both its circle and moving icon.

title: Running Neon Border
visualTrait: A magenta rectangular CTA has four golden light streaks continuously travelling around its edges.
sourceName: Creative Button Animation Effects | Only Using HTML & CSS by Ahmad Emran
captureHint: Capture the button at a moment where multiple animated border streaks are visible.

title: Hold-to-Delete Fill
visualTrait: A small red destructive icon control fills from its center while it is held before triggering deletion.
sourceName: Hold to delete button (bootstrap) by yspreen
captureHint: Press and hold the red X control, then crop it at roughly half-filled progress.

title: Hold-to-Wave Trigger
visualTrait: A plain hold button activates a dynamic SVG sound-wave field below it.
sourceName: Squingly Wave Machine by Giedr-Ju
captureHint: Press and hold, capturing the button together with the activated wave lines.

title: Angled Red 3D Disc
visualTrait: A large red circular CTA is rotated in 3D with a thick offset base and glossy inset highlights.
sourceName: Red Round 3D Button (CSS only) by Oleksandr Shepa
captureHint: Capture the entire red disc and its deep lower-right base shadow.

title: Yellow Skewed Push Button
visualTrait: A bright yellow uppercase button uses a hard diagonal dark shadow to create an arcade-like press effect.
sourceName: 3D Button by screenthink
captureHint: Hover or press the centered yellow button and include its offset brown shadow.

title: Blue Arcade Press
visualTrait: A rounded cyan button drops its solid eight-pixel base when pressed for a simple tactile response.
sourceName: Simple 3D Button CSS only by tomizius-the-sasster
captureHint: Capture before and during active press to show the lowered state.

title: SVG Click Ripple
visualTrait: A broad material-pink button launches a scalable SVG circle ripple exactly from the click point.
sourceName: A Pen by Ludvig Lindblom
captureHint: Click off-center and capture the expanding darker ripple inside the button bounds.

title: Rotating Liquid Pill
visualTrait: A cyan rounded pill contains a large translucent rotating liquid surface and shifts neon-green on hover.
sourceName: Liquid Button Hover Effect (CSS Only, Responsive) by Ahmod Musa
captureHint: Hover the pill and capture the rotating liquid texture through its clipped rounded edge.

title: Orange Isometric Press
visualTrait: An orange rectangular button has faux isometric side faces and a hard down-left press translation.
sourceName: CSS 3D Button 1 by mudontire
captureHint: Capture both the resting faux side faces and the pressed lower position.

title: Material Ink Ripple
visualTrait: A flat blue text CTA uses a contained circular ink ripple layer in a classic Material-style interaction.
sourceName: Ripple.js - Material Design Ripple Buttons by william-wise
captureHint: Click near a corner to show the expanding darker blue circular ripple.

title: Tilted Social Blocks
visualTrait: A white social button is heavily rotated and skewed with extruded-looking side faces and an icon-plus-label layout.
sourceName: Fake 3D Button Only With CSS Final Version by evolab
captureHint: Crop one social button with its icon, text, skewed geometry, and shadow fully visible.

title: 3D Loading State
visualTrait: A cyan depth button swaps into a disabled loading state with a compact spinning ring and visible focus treatment.
sourceName: 3D Buttons & Microinteractions – Pure CSS Depth + Press States by adiadila123
captureHint: Capture the Loading state before it changes to Loaded, including spinner and layered depth shadow.

title: Progress Morph CTA
visualTrait: A dedicated demo collection turns conventional submit controls into visual progress indicators and completion states.
sourceName: Progress Button Styles
captureHint: Click a Submit variant, then crop it midway through its progress or final success transformation.
